CALL-0009.notes: R4: the agent tells the borrower's colleague that Karan 'has an outstanding personal loan of 55,000 rupees with our company' and that 'He has missed several payments, and we haven't received the amount despite multiple reminders', and continues after the colleague objects ('That's private information').

rule_reasoning.R4: true - debt details (existence, amount, missed payments) disclosed to someone other than the borrower, matching 'Never discuss debt details with family members, employers, or anyone other than the borrower'.
rule_reasoning.R6: false, BUT A JUDGMENT CALL. First agent turn gives name and company, and says only 'regarding Mr. Karan Malhotra'. The purpose of the call (an outstanding loan) is stated in the second agent turn. The rule is scoped to the first 1-2 agent turns, so it is satisfied; a stricter 'purpose in the opening line' reading would make it true. A labeller should confirm this reading.
